questions.q: In "What sensors measure Understand", which of these is a key idea?
o: Steps come from motion; heart rate from light on the skin or a chest strap; sleep from movement and heart rate; calories are estimates.
Fit the device snugly; set height, weight and age correctly; choose the right activity type.

Read what the app collects and shares; turn off location sharing and public maps near your home.
